payload.title: haiku conflates hold-and-amend with stop-the-plan on an operator change mid-plan
payload.body: mav-position cold read, 3 rounds x opus-5.5 and haiku-4.5 (/tmp/corrected-shards-cold-read/mav-position/): every read passed (a)-(g),(i); haiku round 1 answered (h) as capture a decision note BLOCKING the plan, amend once, planner re-plans, i.e. the wrong-shard stop path, instead of holding a non-blocking note until the plan closes. Rounds 2 and 3 answered (h) correctly. The wording comes from the role's amend(C) clause and the design skill, not from mav.ts.
